content: Pull my recent activities and give me a plan for the weekend.

Your recent rides were both steady endurance: **90min Wednesday (Load 55)** and **2h Friday (Load 85)**. Latest readiness looks good—**Fitness 55, Fatigue 48, Form +7**, with stable resting HR and about 7.5h sleep—so a controlled quality day plus endurance is appropriate.

### Saturday, July 11 — Sweet spot 2×15
Warmup: 15min progressive, 50–70% FTP  
Main: 2×15min at 88–92% FTP, 5min easy at 50–55% between  
Cooldown: 10min below 55% FTP  
Estimated: 60min, Intensity 0.78–0.82, Load 60–70  
Why: Adds productive sustained work without a large jump from your recent endurance riding.

### Sunday, July 12 — Endurance
Warmup: 10min at 50–65% FTP  
Main: 70min at 60–72% FTP, conversational effort  
Cooldown: 10min below 55% FTP  
Estimated: 90min, Intensity 0.65–0.70, Load 65–75  
Why: Builds aerobic volume while keeping fatigue manageable after Saturday.

If your legs feel unusually heavy Saturday or resting HR is clearly elevated, skip the sweet spot and keep the whole ride easy below 70% FTP.
